caso.texto:
Clear Line offers work-order organisation. The contact has one minute, uses an incumbent and has not measured delays. The exercise list is approved, but there is no permission to record real calls. After two questions the contact asks not to be called again.

A Cleveland service business requires an IT review before changing tools. The call is a fictional practice in a permitted training setting; no US calling permission is inferred. The owner requests a written summary before any meeting.

projeto.instrucoes: Write a 30-second opening, two questions and three endings: busy, requested material and final refusal. Perform the refusal branch without overriding the restriction.
projeto.gabarito: Identify company and purpose; check relevance and the actual difficulty. Offer another time only if wanted. Send only requested material. On refusal, close and record the restriction without recording or calling from another number.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
